paragraphs: Ketubot 91a relates: the property of the household of Bar Tzartzur was small and then increased. They came before Rav Amram, who sent them before Rav Nachman, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The two consulted Ketubot 91a paragraphs describe the property increasing and the household coming to Rav Amram, who sends them to Rav Nachman. This is the named household occurrence; no separate personal identity is inferred.
